description: [Trip-Pups(트립펍스) — 외국인 축제 찾기·신청] Return a short Trip-Pups link for an event's sign-up page (or its official page if there is no separate sign-up page), for sharing on a given channel. Opening the link counts one click for that event and channel (no personal data is stored) and then redirects to the page, tagged with UTM parameters.
